sections.appearance: Kasumi has messy, thigh-length dark brown hair with fitting bangs and golden eyes. She has an ahoge and two dark brown horns with dark red tips on the back of her head. Additionally, she has a tail, with its end resembling a two-forked trident. She has a cute little fang on the right. Swimsuit: Her hair was tied back in two pigtails. Halo ==== Kasumi's halo is a white ring with a dark red outline, with five separate abstract parts that together resemble a flame and a curved triangle below. Uniform ==== Kasumi wears a red dress shirt, black short shorts and an oversized lab coat that she usually carries on her forearms. The dress shirt is slightly unbuttoned, revealing her collarbones, and tucked into her short. However,her shorts are so short that her clothes stick out from the leg openings. swimsuit: She's wearing a bikini, black pants, a white and red striped top, with an oversized science lab coat over it, similar to the original. sections.personality: Kasumi has one thing in mind, and that's developing more hot springs. She shows a smug personality from her facial expressions alone and will go for extreme measures to develop more hot springs. Kasumi also has a deep boyish voice despite her mischievous child-like appearance. It is later revealed that Kasumi has extensive connections to the criminal underworld, incredible organizational skills, and a highly charismatic personality. Because of this, she turned the Hot Springs Development Department from a minor club into one of Gehenna's most notorious outfits, and can easily rally delinquents and gang members to do her bidding if she needs a distraction or an exit strategy in particular. Her emotional intelligence is also very high, having correctly deduced Nakamasa Ichika's barely-contained aggression. Her confidence however, shatters when Sorasaki Hina in particular shows up, often leaving her a sobbing, begging mess.
